businesses.business: building engineering, installation and maintenance services

offering_description.value: Provides engineering, consulting, installation and maintenance services for the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems of commercial, institutional and industrial buildings. Customers include owners and operators of data centers, healthcare, life sciences, higher education and similar facilities. It delivers through design engineering, project installation and recurring service and maintenance work.

primary_services.value: engineering and consulting; HVAC and mechanical system installation; building systems maintenance and repair; energy efficiency and sustainability services; building controls and automation

customer_segment.value: B2B: data center operators, healthcare systems, life sciences firms, universities, commercial and industrial building owners; B2G: public institutions and government facilities

end_markets.value: data centers; healthcare; life sciences; higher education; commercial real estate; industrial facilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: installation and construction projects and engineering design engagements; service fees: recurring maintenance, repair, monitoring and consulting services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment and labor to engineer, install and maintain building systems for building owners and operators

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across the United States, with a network of regional offices

specialization.value: related lines: engineering and consulting, installation, and maintenance services for building systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct bids and long-term relationships with building owners, developers and facility operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Contractor licensing, building and electrical codes, safety (OSHA) and environmental and energy rules apply

notes: Details on scale and mix come from general knowledge and may be dated.
